documents.title: Benton County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 94 pages. Amounts are the Schedule 2 category columns (Total Personnel Svcs., Supplies, Other Svcs & Charges, Capital, Debt) and 'Total Dept.' for 2026 column.

documents.title: Benton County 2026 budget (as reported)
documents.note: Figures as reported in local news of the Quorum Court’s 2026 budget adoption. The full ordinance is public record; the artransparency.gov copy blocks automated access, so line-item ingestion awaits a direct pull.
